boxes.name: A
boxes.note: Core box A. Issue #187: terrain scenery grid for the EAST RIM — the grid rectangle (121.565-121.635 x 25.020-25.055) is a backdrop extent, not tile ground: it skins the Sishou/Nangang slopes inside the box's east edge and continues east past the 121.580 tile edge so the range has depth. North edge 25.055 = the box's own top (zero overlap with the airport box/airfield); Xiangshan (25.0267) sits inside the grid's south margin.

boxes.name: B
boxes.note: West column, exactly as live since PR #70. RESTORED as its own box by issue #102 amendment 2 (user, 2026-10-24 23:42): the live footprint is frozen as the base — live ground is never dropped, so B stays whole (121.503-121.535 x 25.055-25.060) and the corridor's one-width absorption must NOT drop B's eastern sliver (121.533-121.535). The corridor box overlaps B in 121.503-121.533 x 25.055-25.060; union semantics make the overlap a no-op.

boxes.name: 3-corridor
boxes.note: MRT Red Line corridor (issue #102): follows the Red Line's geography via the road network (MRT is not rendered). Starts at lat 25.055 at width 121.503-121.533, overlapping box B (see B's note — the overlap is intentional; B's eastern sliver stays live under amendment 2's frozen-live-footprint rule). WEST EDGE EXTENDED 121.503 -> 121.494 by issue #134 (user, 2026-10-25): the strip 121.494-121.503 x 25.055-25.133 joins the tile, aligning with the incinerator connector's west line; the genuinely new ground is 121.494-121.503 x 25.055-25.104 (the rest was already live via boxes 4/5). The strip is mostly Tamsui water + the Shezi south shore; the #137 riverside rule applies to it from day one.

boxes.name: 4-beitou
boxes.note: Guandu/Beitou (issue #102), where the Red Line turns west.

boxes.name: 5-incinerator
boxes.note: Connector (issue #102): covers the Beitou Incinerator (25.1079, 121.4990) in the notch between the corridor (west edge 121.503) and Box 4 (south edge 25.113); shares an edge with both. Since issue #134 extended the corridor's west edge to 121.494, this box's rect is fully inside the corridor's — kept as the minuted record of why this ground is live; union semantics make the overlap a no-op.

boxes.name: 6-airport
boxes.note: Songshan Airport box (issue #134, user 2026-10-25). Edges from the measured airfield: the aerodrome boundary (OSM relation 5421750) spans lon 121.5384-121.5682 x lat 25.0617-25.0721 (runway 10/28 centreline 121.5396-121.5654, width tag 60 m, stopway to 121.5677). West edge 121.533 = the corridor box's east edge (shared segment 25.055-25.075 keeps the union connected and brings in the Dajia riverside frontage); south edge 25.055 = box A's north edge (shared 121.533-121.570); east 121.570 gives the stopway ~180 m of margin; north 25.078 takes in the Yingfeng riverside park, the levee and most of the Keelung River's width at this reach. The airfield itself is a SPECIAL SITE: the planner drops every procedural lot inside the aerodrome boundary (issue #134); the terminal + parking structures are issue #135. Issue #187: terrain scenery grid for the NORTH RIM EAST — the grid rectangle (121.540-121.615 x 25.110-25.165) is a backdrop extent, not tile ground: it skins the Yangmingshan front range and the Dalun/Neihu hills BEHIND the #186 airport-north strip. South edge 25.110 sits ~333 m north of the strip's 25.107 edge on purpose: the museum grounds and the strip's hill foot stay on the flat convention (no skin, no drape — #132 is separate). West edge 121.540 = the corridor grid's east edge (shared lattice postings, seamless join). Issue #186 (user, 2026-10-26): north edge 25.078 -> 25.107 — the airport-north strip: same lon span 121.533-121.570, growing the box to the National Palace Museum. Measured grounds (OSM way 827791918, landuse=recreation_ground): lat 25.09908-25.10407 x lon 121.54701-121.55056, so 25.107 covers the grounds with ~330 m of hill-foot margin; the Wenhu line resurfaces in this strip (Dazhi + Jiannan Rd stations). The strip's own rules from day one: Keelung banks = #137 riverside, NPM grounds = #114 green / #149 special site.

comment: Taipei tile = union of these boxes (issue #60 pipeline). FINAL #102 footprint per amendment 2 (user, 2026-10-24 23:42, governing rule: 'current live -> if we didn't trim it, don't add a new northern part' — the live footprint is frozen as the base): live A + live B (whole) + Red Line corridor + Guandu/Beitou box + incinerator connector. The southern band S (asked in the original #102 text) was REMOVED by the user in the same amendment, and the core-ne-notch restore (amendment 1, 23:32) was reversed — the notch was never live, so it is not added. Origin stays Taipei 101. EXPANSION ROUND 2 (issue #134, user 2026-10-25): corridor west edge 121.503 -> 121.494 for its full length + new box 6-airport for Songshan Airport; nothing previously live was dropped. EXPANSION ROUND 3 (issue #186, user 2026-10-26): box 6-airport north edge 25.078 -> 25.107 (National Palace Museum strip); nothing previously live was dropped.
